items.title: Linking Data Visuals With Hypotheses (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Linking Data Visuals With Hypotheses' under topic 7.5 (PDF 101, printed 97).

blocks.text: Data visuals nataij ko seedha hypothesis se jorte hain. In se researchers aankh se dekh sakte hain ke data hypothesis ko support karta hai ya reject. Maslan ek comparison graph control group aur experimental treatment group ka farq dikha sakta hai. Line graph ke trends mutawaqqa nataij ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain. Scatter plots hypothesis mein bataye gaye rishte pehchanne mein madad dete hain. Tasveeri saboot hypothesis testing mein mantiqi soch ko mazboot karta hai, is liye data visualization hypothesis ko sahi ya ghalat sabit karne mein bari madad deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa chart behtareen dikhayega ke treatment group ke average number control group se zyada the, aur phir bhi test kyun karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Do groups ke means ka bar chart. Chart farq dikhata hai, lekin sirf hypothesis test batata hai ke farq ittifaq se bara hai ya nahi.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 7.5 Data Visualization For Hypothesis Testing

items: Visualization testing se pehle aur baad patterns, farq aur outliers dikhati hai.
Bar: groups ka muqabla; line: waqt ke saath trend; pie: hisse; scatter: do variables ka rishta.
Charts faisle ko support karte hain magar test ki jagah nahi lete.
